## Updates

- Activity filtering reuses weekly results for smoother navigation in the Hub and workspace.
- Inspector tabs have smoother corners and cleaner borders in docked and detached windows.

## Fixes

- Images embedded as HTML in pull request descriptions now appear alongside the text.

## Supported machines and installation

Windows 10 or 11, 64-bit Intel or AMD (x64).

Download and run `gitorian-0.1.12-windows-x64-setup.exe` from **Assets** below to install Gitorian. Existing installations can download this update in the background and restart when ready.

See the [installation details](https://github.com/XII-A/gitorian#downloads) for unsigned installer warnings and checksums.
